build_stream_auth_username.description: Username for Build Stream OAuth Registration is Mandatory when Build Stream is enabled. Must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, dots, or hyphens. Length must be between 4 and 64 characters.

build_stream_auth_password.description: Password for Build Stream OAuth Registration is Mandatory when Build Stream is enabled. Length must be between 8 and 128 characters and must not contain backslashes (\), hyphens (-), single quotes ('), or double quotes (").

gitlab_root_password.description: Password for GitLab root user. Length must be between 8 and 128 characters and can contain letters, numbers, and special characters.

gitlab_ssh_password.description: Password for GitLab SSH access. Length must be between 4 and 128 characters and can contain letters, numbers, and special characters.

postgres_user.description: Username for Postgres DB. Cannot be 'root'. Allowed characters: letters, digits, and underscore (_). Length must be between 4 and 32 characters.

postgres_password.description: Password for Postgres DB. Length must be between 8 and 128 characters and can contain letters, numbers, and special characters from !  #  $  %  ^  &  *  (  )  _  +  =  ,  .  ?  <  >  ;  {  }  [  ]  |
